title: Ukraine and Russia exchange 185 prisoners of war each
content: Ukraine and Russia exchange 185 prisoners of war each Ukraine and Russia exchange 185 prisoners of war each Russia and Ukraine have each released 185 prisoners in a major exchange, which Russia says was mediated by the UAE. Ukraine said the returned group included soldiers, officers and a civilian, with many having been held in captivity since the early months of the war in 2022. Published On 5 Jun 2026
